name: The Wish
designNote: Aha: the wish altars sit at the same spot in both worlds, so the coin can only be made whole with the halves lined up. Sol takes the mirror so they walk toward each other along the top; lining up puts Sol's Tarnish to sleep, and they step onto the altars together, both still holding their half-coins.
hints: Both wish altars are at the same place. How do you bring the halves together?
Use the mirror and meet above the altars, then step down together.
